description: A comprehensive, production-ready C# client library for Allegro REST API. Provides 170+ methods covering 95% of all Allegro endpoints across 35 specialized clients. Features: strongly-typed requests/responses, async/await throughout, 11 specialized exception types, built-in retry logic with exponential backoff, rate limit handling, complete XML documentation, 200+ unit tests. Supports: offers, products, orders, fulfillment, categories, images, shipping, payments, billing, messaging, disputes, returns, badges, classifieds, EU compliance (GPSR), and more. Production-ready for .NET 8.0+
releaseNotes:
# Release Notes

## Version 1.5.0 (October 2025) - Current

### New Features - Fulfillment & Marketplace
- ✨ **FulfillmentClient** - Complete Allegro Fulfillment services (17 methods)
  - Advance Ship Notices (ASN) management - create, update, submit, cancel
  - Stock management with filtering and sorting
  - Order parcels and available products retrieval
  - Tax ID management for international shipping
  - Removal preferences configuration
- ✨ **ListingClient** - Public offers search and browsing (4 methods)
  - Search by phrase, category, seller
  - Full search with advanced filters
- ✨ **BadgesClient** - Badge campaigns and applications (6 methods)
  - Campaign management
  - Badge applications CRUD
  - Operations tracking
- ✨ **ClassifiedsClient** - Classifieds packages and promotions (4 methods)
  - Package management
  - Offer-package assignments
  - Category-specific configurations
- ✨ **DisputeAttachmentsClient** - Dispute attachments handling (3 methods)
  - Binary file upload/download
  - Attachment declaration
- ✨ **Additional Services** - Extended SaleExtensionsClient (6 methods)
  - Groups, categories, translations management
- ✨ **Offer Attachments** - Extended AdvancedOffersClient (3 methods)
  - Attachment upload, listing, deletion
- ✨ **Fundraising Campaigns** - Extended MiscellaneousClient (1 method)
  - Charity campaign search

### Improvements
- 🎯 Increased API coverage from 86% to **95%** (170+/180 endpoints)
- 🚀 Added 44 new API methods across 5 new clients
- 📦 Added 80+ new model classes for enhanced functionality
- 🔧 Extended `AllegroHttpClient` with `PostRawAsync`, `PutRawAsync`, `ReadJsonAsync` for binary data handling
- ✅ All 35 clients registered in `AllegroApiClient`
- 📝 Complete XML documentation for all new methods and models
- 🏗️ Build succeeds with 0 errors, production-ready
- 🧪 Expanded test suite to 200+ unit tests (100% pass rate)
- 🌍 Full sandbox environment support for all new features

### API Coverage
- **FulfillmentClient:** 0 → 17 methods (NEW) - Complete warehouse management
- **ListingClient:** 0 → 4 methods (NEW) - Public offers discovery
- **BadgesClient:** 0 → 6 methods (NEW) - Badge campaigns management
- **ClassifiedsClient:** 0 → 4 methods (NEW) - Classifieds promotions
- **DisputeAttachmentsClient:** 0 → 3 methods (NEW) - Binary file handling
- **SaleExtensionsClient:** Extended with 6 methods - Additional services management
- **AdvancedOffersClient:** Extended with 3 methods - Offer attachments
- **MiscellaneousClient:** 14 → 15 methods (+1) - Charity campaigns
- **Total Methods:** 150 → 170+ (+20)
- **Total Clients:** 30 → 35 (+5)

### Breaking Changes
None - Fully backward compatible with v1.4.0

### Migration Notes
No migration required. All existing code continues to work without modifications.
